entities.summary: Adam John Hall is an American former professional ice hockey player. A second round selection of the Nashville Predators in the 1999 NHL entry draft, Hall played in the National Hockey League for the Nashville Predators, New York Rangers, Minnesota Wild, Pittsburgh Penguins, Tampa Bay Lightning, Carolina Hurricanes and Philadelphia Flyers. He finished his career in the National League (NL), playing three seasons for HC Ambrì-Piotta.
